editorial_reason: Important original-INDEPENDENT-reconstruction defect: existing meaning text begins 'A nonempty topological space X is connected if...' This unnecessarily excludes the empty topological space under the standard no-separation convention; the ProofWiki source imposes no nonempty premise. Amend this meaning in place with a full source-attributed historic correction, not a duplicate meaning; preserve its old reviewed source and link decisions. The current formulation also conflates the no-separation and clopen characterizations into one sentence; the project policy prefers separate equivalent formulations under the same heading.

The existing independently sourced Noetherian-ring meaning has two equivalent characterizations inside one formulation. ProofWiki confirms four mathematically equivalent characterizations for commutative unital rings. Review as separate formulations under the same already screened context instead of adding another meaning. In a general noncommutative ring left/right Noetherian are distinct: do not omit commutativity if retaining the same source scope.
